verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents background autonomy: Ari keeps the Model current, rebuilds it overnight, and messages you when something moves without being asked. Users can change the nightly connection refresh time, and Sheets/Drive imports update when the file changes. The pricing page also lists "Proactive alerts & triggers." These are mostly built-in behaviors, though, and there is no documentation of user-defined automations (custom rules, schedules or trigger-to-action workflows) beyond that one pricing line. Missing for 10: docs on how users create and configure their own triggers or automations, scheduled tasks beyond sync timing, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the background runs work.
